scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
Thank you for coming through the rough sand storms. Welcome to ^8B4513Veins^000000, the Canyon Village.
If this is the first time for you to use the guide services, why don't you check the "Notice" menu first?
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯嚮導]
穿越風沙辛苦了，歡迎來到峽谷村莊^8B4513伯仁斯^000000。
第一次找嚮導的話，不妨先看看“告示”選單。
[神殿]
[旅館]
[酒館]
[武器店]
[道具店]
[機場]
[地質研究所]
[酷活動公司職員]
移除小地圖示記
取消

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
The {0} is always filled with praying the faithful of the incarnation of goddess Freya.
It's located on the North side of Veins.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯嚮導]
{0}裡總有許多信徒，向芙蕾雅女神的化身祈禱。
它位於伯仁斯北部。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
You can rest your fatigue of the journey in the {0}. The Inn is located on the North-West side of Veins.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯嚮導]
到{0}歇歇，就能緩解旅途疲勞。
旅館位於伯仁斯西北部。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
If you want to talk to the Veins Towners, visit the Veins {0}.
The pub is located on the west side of Veins.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯嚮導]
如果您想和伯仁斯的鎮民聊聊，就去伯仁斯的{0}吧。
酒館位於伯仁斯的西側。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
You have to be able to protect your own body.
The {0} in Veins is selling the good weapons at a reasonable price..
It is located on the West side of Veins.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯嚮導]
出門在外，要能保護好自己。
伯仁斯的{0}就在城鎮西邊，武器質優價廉。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
The essential items! Check out the Veins {0} in the center of town..
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯嚮導]
旅行必需品，可別漏了！
去城鎮中央的{0}看看吧。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
The {0} of Veins is currently only used for Cargo.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯嚮導]
伯仁斯的{0}目前只用於貨運。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
Are you interested in Geology?
If so, please visit the 
{0} at the second floor of Weapon Shop.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯嚮導]
您對地質學感興趣嗎？
如果感興趣，請前往武器店二樓的{0}。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
I will mark the location
of the {0}
on your mini map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯嚮導]
我會在您的小地圖上標記{0}的位置。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
Sure, I'll remove all marks from your mini-map.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯嚮導]
好的，我會清除您小地圖上的所有標記。
還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

[伯仁斯嚮導]
祝您一路平安！
